Root conditional check: Conditional cardinality check prompted by the written cardinal 3 and representation reguliere beside a crossed group symbol. A regular group action has orbit in bijection with its acting group (g maps to g applied to the identity/base element); hence a group of six distinct elements has a six-element regular orbit. Scan022 lists six group elements, while a cyclic subgroup generated by rho has three. This highlights possible intended subgroup or overwritten notation, but does not identify the crossed glyph or prove a source error. The visible cardinal 3, reguliere, and unresolved group/deletion state are preserved.
